questions.answer: BA

questions.answer: I thought the level varied a bit between courses, some were easy but i also had one that was very hard

questions.answer: generally yes, but they dont use books as much and there is not always clear learning goals

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Innovative cell biology and immunology
Evolutionary psycology
Brain in trouble
The developing brain
Allergy and autoimmunity

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Brain in trouble, The developing brain, Allergy and autoimmunity are all very interesting the first two are a bit easier as they are for students of other things than natural sciences aswell. Innovative cell biology and immunology is also good, but it is highly recommended to have had an immunology course previosly.
